method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks bounce as Apple earnings near, oil falls
Equities.reason: Short-term intraday bounce ahead of a major earnings catalyst (Apple). Signals temporary relief but limited change to the broader risk-off AI/tech narrative, so modest positive impact on equities.

Equities.title: US Stocks Halt Selloff as Oil Prices Retreat: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Market-wrap describing a pause in the selloff tied to oil moves — indicates reduction in immediate downside momentum. Relevant for near-term risk sentiment but not a decisive regime shift.

Equities.title: Stock futures rebound ahead of busy week of earnings, jobs data and the midterm elections
Equities.reason: Futures uptick ahead of major macro/earnings/catalyst calendar — a short-term positive signal reflecting positioning ahead of data and political events, limited longer-term conviction.

Equities.title: Deutsche Bank upgrades US tech, says selloff has gone too far
Equities.reason: Major bank upgrade of the largest market sector (US tech) is a meaningful counter-signal to the AI-led rout and supports a potential tactical rebound in the market leadership that dominates indices.

Equities.title: After Tech Sell-Off, Investors Brace for More Market Volatility
Equities.reason: Highlights elevated volatility and investor caution after a concentrated tech sell-off — reinforces negative risk sentiment and higher market-wide uncertainty.

Equities.title: Foreigners Make Record Withdrawal From Taiwan Stocks on AI Rout
Equities.reason: Large cross-border selling tied to the AI-led correction is a high-relevance flow signal: market-wide implication for tech supply chains and EM equity vulnerability, amplifying the negative regime.

Equities.title: Global AI sell-off eases after Nasdaq’s worst month in over a year
Equities.summary: US tech stocks set to start week higher following bruising rout
Equities.reason: Notes an easing in the AI-driven sell-off and a prospective rebound in tech; represents a modestly positive development but framed as a tactical recovery after a severe drawdown.

Equities.title: Morning Bid: Markets hope for relief in Apple margins
Equities.reason: Focus on Apple margins as a potential relief point for the market — earnings-linked catalyst that could materially influence market sentiment given Apple's weight in indices.

Equities.title: Wall Street Braces for More Wild Days in Stocks After Tech Rout
Equities.reason: Reinforces expectation of continued volatility and downside risk following the concentrated tech sell-off — supports a negative, risk-averse market regime outlook.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: FOMC statements are primary drivers of US rate expectations. The Fed's communications in late Oct are the dominant input for 'higher-for-longer' pricing; this is materially negative for bond prices (yields higher).

Rates.title: Wall Street Braces for Biggest Treasury Sales Overhaul in Years
Rates.reason: Reports of a major change to Treasury sales/distribution increase the expected net supply and technical pressure on the curve — negative for bond prices and supportive of higher yields.

Rates.title: PBOC Conducts Overnight Reverse Repo as Policy Anchor Shifts
Rates.reason: PBOC open-market operations and any shift in its operational anchor influence Chinese money-market rates and regional liquidity. An active reverse-repo injection is supportive for bond prices (reduces short-term funding stress).

Rates.title: Decisions taken by the Governing Council of the ECB (in addition to decisions setting interest rates)
Rates.reason: Official ECB Governing Council decisions (beyond headline rate calls) shape euro-area term premia and liquidity. Recent ECB actions/communications are a material driver of EUR-core yields; here the impact is bond-negative in the prevailing tightening/higher-rate context.

Rates.title: Monetary policy decisions
Rates.reason: ECB monetary policy decisions drive euro-area rate expectations and curve moves. Given the recent tightening backdrop, these items are net negative for bond prices (upward pressure on yields).

Rates.title: Christine Lagarde, Boris Vujčić: Monetary policy statement (with Q&A)
Rates.reason: The ECB president's policy statement and Q&A convey forward guidance that influences term structure. The communication reinforces the tightening narrative, modestly negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: ECB President Lagarde to step down on 7 February 2027
Rates.reason: Governor succession announcements raise medium-term policy uncertainty and can affect term premia. This is a modest negative for bonds due to potential uncertainty around future policy path.

Rates.title: Statement on Monetary Policy
Rates.reason: BOJ monetary policy statements and guidance remain a dominant influence on JGB yields. Continued policy accommodation and operational JGB purchases are supportive for bond prices (lower yields) in the current posture.

Rates.title: Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds (Competitive Auction Method) (October-December 2026) (Schedule Updates)
Rates.reason: Updated JGB purchase schedules directly affect supply/demand in the JGB market. Continued outright purchases are supportive for bond prices (restrains yields).

Rates.title: Polish Zloty: Inflation dip seen delaying tightening – Commerzbank
Rates.summary: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose reports Poland’s October flash Consumer Price Index (CPI) slowed to 3.5% year-on-year versus 4.1% in September, with prices down 0.3% month-on-month, likely delaying National Bank of Poland tightening.
Rates.reason: A softer-than-expected CPI print pointing to delayed NBP tightening reduces near-term policy-rate risk and is modestly supportive for Polish bond prices (lower yields).

FX.title: CEE FX: Dovish stance and energy shock pressure currencies – ING
FX.summary: ING strategist Frantisek Taborsky outlines a busy week for Central and Eastern European (CEE) markets, with PMI, inflation and industrial data across Turkey, Hungary and the Czech Republic, plus policy decisions from Poland and the Czech National Bank.
FX.reason: Regional CEE FX piece signals downside pressure on local currencies from dovish policy and energy shock — implies local currency weakness (USD strength vs CEE) which is a negative USD-centric FX signal; relevant for EMFX flows but not a global USD pivot.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: DXY slides to 101.75; seems vulnerable below 100-hour SMA
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, struggles to capitalize on Friday's modest bounce from the 101.60 region and attracts fresh sellers at the start of a new week.
FX.reason: DXY technical/flow note showing slide in the dollar — direct USD signal that supports broad non-USD currency strength; higher relevance because DXY moves drive cross-market FX flows ahead of midterms.

FX.title: Euro strengthens above 1.1150 as Eurozone GDP beats forecasts, US midterm election looms
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair gathers strength to near 1.1175 during the early European trading hours on Monday. The Euro (EUR) edges higher against the US Dollar (USD) as the Eurozone and German Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data beat forecasts in the third quarter (Q3).
FX.reason: Macro upside surprise for euro-area growth is a clear pro-EUR fundamental driver versus USD; this reinforces a euro-strength USD-weakness narrative and is directly relevant to EUR/USD flows.

FX.title: Euro holds gains, as lower Oil prices offset weak German Retail Sales figures
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) appreciates 0.2% against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday as a moderate risk appetite, with Oil prices pulling down from highs, has offset investors' disappointment about the weak German consumption figures.
FX.reason: Intraday EUR/USD move partly driven by oil and risk sentiment — modest positive for EUR vs USD but limited market-moving impact (small move, mixed drivers).

FX.title: Forex Today: US Dollar edges lower as mood improves ahead of midterm elections
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Monday, November 2:
FX.reason: Daily FX wrap indicating USD edging lower on improved risk tone and midterm-related positioning — useful for gauging broad USD flow but not a single strong shock.

FX.title: British Pound: Resistance at 1.3435 caps upside against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank (UOB) strategists Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note GBP/USD trading around 1.3390 after a sharp rise and subsequent pullback. In the short term, the British Pound (GBP) is expected to range between 1.3360 and 1.3420. Over 1–3 weeks, pric
FX.reason: Dealer/technical note on GBP/USD resistance — indicates mild GBP upside vs USD but is price-forecast/technical in nature, so lower relevance to macro FX regime.

FX.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Sticks to bullish near 1.3400 ahead of BoE decision on Wednesday
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair attracts some dip-buyers at the start of a new week and climbs back to the 1.3400 mark during the Asian session, stalling its modest pullback from the highest level since September 16 set on Friday.
FX.reason: Short-term bullish technical/positioning piece ahead of BoE — supports GBP-positive/ USD-negative bias but is a tactical note with limited broader regime impact.

FX.title: Indian Rupee extends gains amid sharp correction in oil prices
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends previous trading day’s gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday on the back of a sharp correction in oil prices. As of writing, the USD/INR pair is down 0.23% to near 94.72.
FX.reason: Oil-driven relief boosting INR vs USD is a direct USD-pair move for an important EMFX (USD/INR); medium relevance given India's size and oil sensitivity.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah declines following mixed economic data
FX.summary: USD/IDR gains after two days of losses, trading around 18,180 during Asian hours on Monday. The currency pair appreciated as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) remained subdued following the release of a mix of domestic economic data.
FX.reason: IDR weakness vs USD after mixed domestic data — EMFX-specific move signaling local softness; limited broader FX regime impact but relevant for Asia/EM flows.

FX.title: Australian Dollar dips further amid mixed data with RBA decision in focus
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) is portraying one of the weakest performances among major currencies on Monday, and dips further against the US Dollar (USD), amid mixed Australian macroeconomic figures and bright Chinese manufacturing activity figures.
FX.reason: AUD underperformance vs USD driven by mixed domestic data and RBA rate expectations — meaningful for AUD/USD flows and commodity-linked FX positioning.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Holds above 0.7000; 100-day EMA holds the key ahead of RBA
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair shows minor downward movement at the start of a new week, trading near the 0.7020 region, down around 0.15% for the day during the Asian session. Traders, however, might refrain from placing fresh directional bets ahead of the Reserve Bank of
FX.reason: Technical/positioning note on AUD/USD ahead of RBA — short-term bearish tilt but limited macro impact (price-forecast nature limits relevance).

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar weakens following China’s RatingDog Manufacturing PMI data
FX.summary: NZD/USD extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 0.5620 during Asian hours on Monday.
FX.reason: NZD softness tied to China PMI and demand concerns — relevant for ANZ currency flows vs USD but not a global regime shift.

FX.title: Swiss Franc remains stronger following SVME PMI data
FX.summary: USD/CHF depreciates after posting minor gains in the previous trading day, hovering around 0.8220 during the European hours on Monday. The pair remains subdued as the Swiss Franc (CHF) holds gains following the release of domestic economic data.
FX.reason: CHF strength vs USD after domestic PMI — direct FX move for a major safe-haven currency; supportive of non-USD currency performance in the session.

FX.title: Japan’s Katayama Says Ready to Act for Stable FX Market
FX.reason: Official (Bloomberg) report that Japanese authorities are prepared to act to stabilize FX is high-impact for JPY and broader USD/JPY flows — implies potential JPY support (non-USD strength) and raises intervention/regime risk relevance.

FX.title: Iran’s Baghaei: Chances of US-Iran diplomacy in next few days exits
FX.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei says basis of diplomacy with the United States (US) is Tehran’s seven steps proposal, and the chances of its implementation over next few days exists.
FX.reason: Improving odds of US-Iran diplomacy reduce geopolitical risk premia and safe-haven dollar demand — supportive for risk-sensitive currencies (GBP/EUR/AUD) and consistent with other USD-softening headlines.

Commodities.title: Gold rises on softer oil; Markets parse Fed signals
Commodities.reason: Macro-driven gold move: softer oil and Fed signal parsing support safe-haven demand and weaker real yields, a constructive near-term driver for gold. Relevance is above average because this reflects cross-asset macro drivers rather than pure intraday technical noise.

Commodities.title: Gold trims intraday gains; trades below $3,900 as Fed hike bets counter weak USD
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) trims part of its modest intraday gains, trading with a mild positive bias below the $3,900 mark during Monday’s early European session.
Commodities.reason: Intraday/technical price action: mild positive bias but capped by Fed hike bets. Classified as technical/price-forecast type so relevance limited (max 0.8).

Commodities.title: Gold: Recovery toward 2027 despite near-term pressure - OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong remain constructive on Gold over the medium term but have lowered price forecasts to USD4,250/oz for end-2026 and USD4,710/oz for end-2027.
Commodities.reason: Medium-term constructive fundamental forecast for gold. This is a forward-looking, high-relevance analyst view that supports the broader gold recovery narrative despite near-term headwinds.

Commodities.title: Gold Climbs Back From One-Year Low as Dip Buyers Arrest Slide
Commodities.reason: Market momentum: dip-buying arrests the slide, indicating buyer interest at lower levels and supporting short-term price recovery. Treated as a market-structure/momentum signal with moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD recovers strongly as oil prices hit hardly
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up 2.45% to near $50.35 in the European trade on Monday. The white metal bounces back strongly after hitting a fresh almost a year low of $48.86 on Friday, as oil prices have extended their correction.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-forecast recovery from YTD lows; silver follows gold and oil moves. Classified as price-forecast/technical so relevance capped at 0.8 despite strong percentage move.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD awaits move beyond $50.00 to extend recovery from YTD low
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) edges higher at the start of a new week, recovering a part of Friday's heavy losses to sub-$49.00 levels, or a fresh low since November 2025.
Commodities.reason: Near-term technical view: tentative recovery but needs breakout to confirm. Price-forecast piece so relevance limited.

Commodities.title: Oil: Geopolitical risk premium holds as midterms loom – ING
Commodities.summary: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Brent rallied strongly last week, supported by escalating Gulf risks and renewed attacks on Russian refineries.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical supply risk premium is a dominant driver for oil prices; analysts point to Gulf escalation and refinery attacks keeping risk premium elevated. High relevance because it reflects market-wide supply-risk narrative.

Commodities.title: OPEC+ keeps December oil output targets steady ahead of tougher call for 2027
Commodities.reason: Supply-side policy: OPEC+ holding output steady supports price stability/tightness into December and reinforces the existing supply discipline narrative. High relevance due to group-wide policy implications for oil balances.

Commodities.title: UAE Oil Boss Calls for More Stockpiles, Refining Closer to Users
Commodities.reason: Policy/industry signal: call for more stockpiles and local refining implies concern about supply security and could support near-term oil risk premium and demand for storage capacity. Medium-high relevance.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Physical supply disruption risk in Gulf production/transport is a high-impact, near-term bullish factor for oil and refined products. Elevated relevance because it can directly constrain supply and trigger market re-pricing.

Commodities.title: Oil Slips as Report Says Trump to Give Iran Diplomacy More Time
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical de-escalation signal: reports of extended diplomacy reduce the Iran-related risk premium, which can weigh on oil prices. Treated as a meaningful counter-signal but of moderate relevance versus broader tightness narrative.

Commodities.title: LNG imports make up increasing share of Colombia's natural gas supply
Commodities.summary: Colombia is importing more liquefied natural gas (LNG) as domestic production continues to fall. A potential drought this fall and winter could limit the availability of hydroelectric generation and boost the country's demand for natural gas power generation.
Commodities.reason: Fundamental demand shift for LNG/natural gas: rising LNG imports due to falling domestic production and hydro risks point to firmer regional gas demand. Relevant to natural gas/LNG market balances but regional in scope.

Crypto.title: Binance’s $6.3 billion hack raises questions about crypto wallet safety
Crypto.summary: Two high-profile security incidents this week, including the largest crypto theft in history, have raised custody and safety concerns.
Crypto.reason: Major security breach narrative — undermines custody confidence and risk appetite across crypto markets; high systemic relevance and negative flow/asset implications.

Crypto.title: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after record crypto hack
Crypto.reason: Large user withdrawals show immediate liquidity flight and potential exchange-run risk — direct negative for short-term crypto flows and sentiment.

Crypto.title: FBI confirms North Korea's role in $6 billion Binance hack, asks DeFi community to block BTC, ETH, SOL addresses
Crypto.reason: Attribution to a state actor raises sanctions, AML and regulatory/sovereign-risk implications for on-chain flows and institutional counterparties — material negative for market structure.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost $643 million in outflows Friday, and 2026 is barely green now
Crypto.reason: Significant ETF outflows reflect investor de-risking and capital flight from crypto products following the hack — negative for price and liquidity.

Crypto.title: Binance Resumes Withdrawals After Suffering Biggest-Ever Crypto Hack
Crypto.reason: Operational restart is a mitigating factor that reduces run risk and supports market functioning — modest positive for short-term liquidity and sentiment.

Crypto.title: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
Crypto.reason: Stated reimbursement reduces tail-risk to customers and contagion — a partial positive that tempers the negative shock but does not erase structural concerns.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin claws back toward $79,000 as markets shake off crypto's biggest hack
Crypto.reason: Price rebound indicates liquidity and risk-on buyers absorbing shock — a counter-signal showing limited longer-term damage to BTC price trajectory in the immediate term.

Crypto.title: BTCPay, a bitcoin payment tool, tells users to switch off their servers after reports of drained wallets
Crypto.reason: Wider reports of drained wallets and advised operational shutdowns point to contagion of security incidents beyond a single exchange — negative for user trust and decentralised service uptime.

Crypto.title: A Nasdaq-listed company may sell $450 million bitcoin, citing Binance hack and quantum fears
Crypto.reason: Potential large sell-side supply tied to risk-off reactions could exert downward pressure on markets — direct negative for BTC liquidity and price.

Crypto.title: Binance opens crypto withdrawals in phases starting with bitcoin following $6.3 billion hack
Crypto.reason: Phased reopening is a pragmatic step to restore functionality and reduce panic — modestly positive for immediate market operations and customer confidence.
